import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import FunctionTransformer,OneHotEncoder,StandardScaler
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline,make_pipeline
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
p='/private/tmp/course-learner-2026/'
d=pd.read_csv(p+'data/catering_leads.csv').sort_values(['created','lead_id'])
num=['guests','budget_pp','days_to_event','response_hours','repeat_client','tasting','hour','weekday','evening']
cat=['channel','event_type','city','company_size','manager']
def prepare(raw):
    x=raw.copy();created=pd.to_datetime(x.created)
    x['hour']=created.dt.hour;x['weekday']=created.dt.dayofweek;x['evening']=(x.hour>=19).astype(int)
    return x[num+cat]
pre=ColumnTransformer([('num',make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy='median'),StandardScaler()),num),('cat',make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy='constant',fill_value='не указан'),OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore')),cat)])
pipe=Pipeline([('raw',FunctionTransformer(prepare)),('prep',pre),('model',LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000))])
